description: Spiritual Awakening page. Overview → Learn More (Benefits + What to Expect) → Reflection Prompts (7 journaling questions with FAQs)
hero_text: We are powerful beings, and this human life is just an illusion designed to help us learn lessons. Becoming aware is already a huge step forward. The journey may be tough, but it is also the most fulfilling experience you can ever have.
benefits: Feeling connected to life and nature
More compassion for yourself and others
A sense of unity and oneness
what_to_expect: A growing sense of inner strength
A return to joy, wonder, and presence

faqs.a: It can feel intense at times, but it ultimately brings clarity, peace, and freedom.

faqs.q: Why do I feel disconnected from people?
faqs.a: Awakening shifts your perspective. You may outgrow old patterns or relationships.

faqs.q: Is awakening the same as religion?
faqs.a: No. Awakening is a personal experience of inner truth, not a belief system.
You're becoming more aware and present. Emotions surface so they can be healed.
It's a lifelong unfolding. You continue expanding, learning, and remembering who you are.

reflection_prompts: What beliefs am I beginning to question?
What parts of myself am I rediscovering?
Where do I feel fear, and what is beneath it?
What emotions have been asking for my attention?
What feels more true to me now than before?
What am I ready to release?
What does my soul want me to know today?
note: Reflection prompts in Spiritual Awakening are SAVED LOCALLY only (client-side state). No API endpoint for persistence exists in current Glide app. Consider adding to Supabase schema if persistence needed.
